title: Sharp First-Order Lower Bounds for Higher-Order Smooth Nonconvex Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2606.05438v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study the deterministic first-order oracle complexity of finding \(\epsilon\)-stationary points in smooth nonconvex optimization when the objective satisfies higher-order smoothness assumptions. While the classical \(\epsilon^{-2}\) rate is optimal under only Lipschitz gradients, higher-order smoothness leads to accelerated first-order upper bounds, most notably the \(\epsilon^{-7/4}\) rate under Lipschitz Hessians and the \(\epsilon^{-5/3}\) rate under Lipschitz third derivatives. The matching lower bounds, however, have remained open. We resolve this gap by proving a new dimension-free first-order lower bound for higher-order smooth nonconvex functions, valid for every finite smoothness order. In particular, our construction gives a matching \(\Omega(\epsilon^{-7/4})\) lower bound in the Hessian-Lipschitz case and a matching \(\Omega(\epsilon^{-5/3})\) lower bound in the third-order-smooth regime. translated_abstract: 我们研究了在目标函数满足高阶光滑性假设的条件下，光滑非凸优化中寻找 ε-驻点的确定性一阶Oracle复杂度。在仅有Lipschitz梯度的经典设定下，ε^{-2} 速率是最优的；而高阶光滑性可以带来加速的一阶上界，其中最著名的是在Lipschitz Hessian条件下的 ε^{-7/4} 速率，以及在Lipschitz三阶导数条件下的 ε^{-5/3} 速率。然而，与之匹配的下界一直悬而未决。我们通过为高阶光滑非凸函数证明一个新的与维度无关的一阶下界来弥合这一差距，该下界对任意有限光滑阶数均成立。特别地，我们的构造在Hessian-Lipschitz情形下给出了匹配的 Ω(ε^{-7/4}) 下界，在三阶光滑情形下给出了匹配的 Ω(ε^{-5/3}) 下界。该困难实例基于一个……
tldr: 该论文首次为高阶光滑非凸优化证明了与维度无关的一阶Oracle复杂度下界，在Hessian-Lipschitz和三阶光滑情形下分别给出与最优上界匹配的 Ω(ε^{-7/4}) 和 Ω(ε^{-5/3}) 下界，解决了该领域长期悬而未决的最优性差距问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proves the first dimension-free first-order oracle complexity lower bounds for higher-order smooth nonconvex optimization, establishing matching Ω(ε^{-7/4}) and Ω(ε^{-5/3}) lower bounds under Hessian-Lipschitz and third-order smoothness assumptions, thereby closing the long-standing gap with known upper bounds.
